subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class II

source.read: NCERT, Learning Outcomes at the Elementary Stage (2017), English section, read through a copy hosted by the Indian Education Repository (CPR India); CBSE circular 05/2019 asks schools to use it; Class II list
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. A copy of the NCERT document, read through a text summary of the PDF, not the PDF itself. The class books have since changed (Mridang for Classes 1-2, Santoor for 3-5, Poorvi for 6-8, under NCF-SE 2023); their chapters are not listed here and a school may order or extend these outcomes.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.

outcomes.text: Sings songs and rhymes with actions.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Answers questions on stories and poems heard.
Gives a view and asks questions about characters and the story.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Answers greetings and polite words in English.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Listens to short texts read aloud, such as a children's news column.
Follows instructions, for example to draw a picture.
outcomes.note: Tap-this-then-that instructions are practised in First words; drawing from spoken instructions is not.

outcomes.text: Names the characters and the order of events in a story.
outcomes.note: Putting pictures in story order is practised; naming the characters of a whole story is not.

outcomes.text: Reads short texts and answers questions on them.
Draws or writes a few words or sentences in answer to poems and stories.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Writes short sentences with spaces between the words.
Starts sentences with a capital letter and ends them with a full stop.
Uses describing words for size, shape, colour, weight and feel.
Uses he, she and it, and this, that, these and those.
Uses position words such as before and between.
